ITEM 1 | Small round red tomatoes, glossy smooth skin with slight sheen, about 2.5-3 cm diameter, roughly 10 whole pieces clustered in the upper-middle of the plate, some with small green stem scars at the top, firm and intact, no cuts or cooking marks | 120 g

ITEM 2 | Dark brown to purplish-black olives, glossy wrinkled-looking skin with slight oily sheen, about 2-3 cm long oval shape, roughly 12 whole pieces arranged in a curved cluster on the lower half of the plate, firm and intact, uncut, unpitted appearance with a small pointed tip on some | 75 g
